title: High Court Verdict
detail: The High Court reinstated the quota system that had been canceled in 2018, triggering renewed public dissatisfaction.

title: Initial Student Protests Begin
detail: Students at Dhaka University and other campuses began protests against the reinstatement of quotas.

title: Ultimatum Announced
detail: Students issued an ultimatum demanding quota cancellation by 30 June.

title: Nationwide Movement
detail: Simultaneous protests and blockades began across universities and major cities.

title: Violence Erupts
detail: Attacks and clashes involving students were reported in Dhaka and other areas.

title: Police Crackdown and Clashes
detail: Police used tear gas and batons; casualties were reported in multiple locations.

title: Nationwide Peak Conflict
detail: The movement intensified with large-scale clashes and loss of life.

title: Supreme Court Verdict
detail: The Supreme Court reduced quotas and directed that most recruitment be merit-based.

title: Gazette Published
detail: The government published a gazette implementing the revised quota structure.

title: Non-cooperation Movement
detail: Students called for a broader anti-government non-cooperation movement.

title: Political Crisis Reaches Critical Stage
detail: Large demonstrations and clashes spread nationwide as the movement took on a wider political character.
